thread:
ben: heads-up: noticed Android SDK (Retrofit+OkHttp) clients hitting "stalled" streaming requests when using HTTP/2 multiplexing + connection pooling. After a keep-alive ping reply mismatch, the client pins a connection and subsequent calls get queued and then retried loudly. repro + notes below.

ben: repro: use sampleapp with http2 enabled on local proxy, make 6 concurrent small streaming requests, then kill the TCP connection for one stream (simulate network hiccup). Observed: one connection gets marked unhealthy, but okhttp's connection pool still hands out new streams on that connection until the next cleanup, causing many IOExceptions then retries.

ivy: Which OkHttp version? We had some fixes around HTTP/2 stream reset handling in 4.11+.

ben: 4.10.0 on the failing devices. 4.11 helped but theres still a window where Connection.health check returns true because the ping hasn't failed yet. Also on older Androids (8/9) the socket-level keepalive behaves differently.

omar: Could this be aggravated by long readTimeouts + short callTimeouts? If callTimeout triggers cancel while socket is still pooled, pool may return that connection later and the next call experiences a stale state.

ben: yes, we saw callTimeout=60s and readTimeout=120s config. After cancellation we saw pooled Call objects and then 2 quick retries in logs.

tess: short-term: 1) set pingInterval to a small value when http2 is enabled on mobile (e.g., 10s) so unhealthy connections detected faster; 2) use connectionPool.evictAll() on detecting stream-reset patterns in a custom event listener; 3) prefer ephemeral connections for streaming endpoints (retryOnConnectionFailure=false).

omar: For SDK change: add an option enableAggressiveHttp2HealthCheck with defaults off, plus an EventListener that increments a failure counter and evicts the connection if >N within M seconds.

ivy: Also add a small diagnostic header X-RW-Conn-Id and include connection pool stats in mobile telemetry so we can correlate customer reports.

ben: I'll open an issue and attach sampleapp + tcp-proxy recipe. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-android/issues/622 (draft).

devx-bot: New issue created: sdk-android#622 "android: http2 multiplex + pooled stale connections cause retries/queued streams" (assigned to @ben).

omar: Action items: 1) Add EventListener + opt-in flag (owner: omar), 2) Add telemetry for pool/conn-id (owner: ivy), 3) Docs: note about HTTP/2 keepalive tuning and streaming endpoints (owner: tess).

ben: Thanks all. I'll also add a sample test using the proxy to flip connections in CI smoke so we don't regress. :thumbsup:
